biotools.summary: BGWR-Clustering implements a Bayesian geographically weighted regression (BGWR) approach with covariate effect clustering. It integrates a Bayesian geographically weighted regression with post-processing steps using Gaussian mixture models and the Dirichlet process mixture model, designed for analyzing spatial heterogeneous data.
